page.notes: The head reads "IN REGNO SCOTIÆ." with the year 1639 printed centred in the same line; the year is not part of the running head and is left out. The final word is broken as "pecu-" and is given as the catchword. The left edge shows marks from the neighbouring page and some show-through, which were left out. The printed word "coluntur" is set in a ligature and was read with some doubt; the reading "columtur" is also possible. The word "serenifl.rex" is printed with an abbreviation and is copied as printed.
